channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Taiwan Eases Margin Rules Amid AI Stock Sell-off
item.description: Taiwan has eased margin call rules to stabilize its stock market, which has been impacted by a sell-off in artificial intelligence (AI) related stocks. The move aims to calm the chip-heavy market. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
